sources_read.section: full - the prior rolled-back login proxy
Supabase Auth > Sign In with Email and Password (existing Postman request this documents)

scope: openapi.yaml only. Add a documented, non-served reference path for Supabase's own POST /auth/v1/token?grant_type=password login endpoint, using OpenAPI's per-path `servers` override so Swagger UI clearly separates it from the gateway's own routes. No Go code, no new dependency, no router change.

acceptance_criteria.text: openapi.yaml documents /auth/v1/token (POST, grant_type=password query param, apikey header, email/password body) under its own servers entry pointing at the local Supabase URL, with a description stating it is handled by Supabase, not this gateway.
go build/go vet/go test all still pass with zero diff outside api/openapi.yaml.
Running the gateway and hitting /swagger/index.html shows the new path grouped under the Supabase server.

risks: Swagger UI's per-operation `servers` override is a display/grouping aid only — it does not make Swagger UI's 'Try it out' actually call Supabase correctly unless CORS on the local Supabase instance allows it; this is documentation, not a working test harness, and is presented to the user as such.
